title: Repair date classification, precision guidance and vocabulary CI
body:
Jinshu 080 date repairs rejected retrospective labels on existing dated honors/events, while worker instructions advertised Western precision values that production validation rejects. Permit only adding the accepted retrospective label while preserving each claim's other facts, certainty and evidence; preserve it in final-delta replay. Align precision instructions with `year`/`circa`, retaining finer source-calendar detail in `sourceDate`.

The required vocabulary check also timed out during checkout. Fetch its scripts, shared Functions helpers and complete canonical people corpus with sparse checkout. Keep the same tests, canonical-label scan, timeout and full-site build gate.

Validation: 268 date/ownership regression tests and 24 vocabulary/reception/hint tests pass locally; all 2,050 canonical extractions pass the vocabulary scan. Remaining date packets pass native byte admission. Independent review approved the production changes and corrected checkout on the exact final head. Required exact-head CI remains pending. No Jinshu 080 source approval or chapter publication is claimed.
